release_notes:
Pin all workflow runners to ubuntu-24.04

GitHub's ubuntu-latest label migrates to Ubuntu 26 starting Oct 19, 2026 —
tomorrow. issue-license.yml's build job installs PHP 8.4 via the Ondrej PPA
and compiles/copies bolt.so against whatever runner image it gets; an
unannounced OS jump mid-migration-window is exactly the kind of thing that
silently breaks a CI step with no code change to blame. Pinned explicitly
so every license-issuing/support-workflow run stays reproducible.
